title: Shell command wrapper bypass via subshell execution
description: Commands like 'bash -c ./real' allowed execution without prompting when './real' was not explicitly approved
root_cause: PolicyEngine evaluated outer binary 'bash' and failed to classify inner subshell invocation payloads with allowArtifactExecution=false

title: 57 exposed API routes unclassified in route authorization matrix
description: API server exposed 57 routes without explicit permission contracts in the authorization matrix test suite
root_cause: Rapid API feature expansion lacked synchronized authorization route matrix entries for viewer/operator scopes

title: KV-cache VRAM admission rejecting eligible models
description: Scheduler rejected placement requiring 26.55 GB on 24 GB hardware without honoring minContextTokens boundary
root_cause: VRAM KV cache calculation used maximum model context rather than minContextTokens floor when sizing memory footprint

title: Refusal of output token reserve on 8K context models
description: Task planner refused allocation when 4096 reserved tokens left insufficient input context budget
root_cause: Fixed 4096 reserve was applied without proportional scaling or floor adjustments for compact context models

title: CLI fast path (--version/--help) exceeded 350ms budget
description: Running 'wa --version' took ~365ms due to heavyweight module imports (@wazir/core, database, models)
root_cause: Eager loading in formatters.ts imported entire core workspace graph before evaluating simple CLI flags

title: Goal CLI command catalog mismatch and unmounted prompt route
description: Goal Studio API contract tests failed due to mismatched CLI command listings and unhandled 503 fallback
root_cause: Command registration had discrepancy between static enum and runtime commands array; prompt handler returned 200 instead of 503 when uninitialized

title: Journey 3 model discovery table format assertion mismatch
description: End-to-end acceptance test failed asserting raw model IDs instead of formatted CLI summary table output
root_cause: Test assertion was written against v0.1 JSON response instead of v0.2 styled CLI human-readable table

title: Missing local models scored as FAIL rather than BLOCKED
description: Live acceptance test harness scored unavailable LM Studio / Ollama endpoints as test failures
root_cause: Harness lacked distinction between assertion failure and missing infrastructure prerequisite

title: Doctor diagnostics lacked actionable remediation guidance
description: wa doctor reported missing dependencies (keyring, pty) without copy-paste resolution commands
root_cause: Health check reporters only returned binary pass/fail without prescriptive fix recommendations

title: Worker lease fencing edge case during network partition
description: Concurrent worker heartbeat loss could permit double execution before lease fencing confirmed expiration
root_cause: Lease timeout check had race condition between heartbeat tick and task dispatch reconciliation
